==Usage==
TORweb/Patch is a specialized usage of {{Tl|TORweb}} that provides easy access to the Patch Notes webpages, with archivedates provided. Simply use <nowiki>{{TORweb/Patch|6.0}}</nowiki> to generate the {{Tl|TORweb}} citation for the 6.0 patch notes.

[[Category:Internet citation templates]]</noinclude>
